messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Leopard courier! Aap ke liye gift hamper aaya hai — iPhone aur perfume 🎁 Free hai bas delivery charges hain.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Surprise hai shayad koi apna. Sirf 950 rupay advance delivery fee hai, COD system change ho gaya.

messages.text: Address batao main khud le loon office se.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Warehouse door hai sir, fee pehle online hogi phir address share hota hai. Jaldi karo offer expire ho raha hai.
